items.title: How AI Slashed 600-Test-Failure Triage From Days to 90 Minutes
items.summary: By Shireen Nagdive and Riya Suri. In our Engineering Energizers Q&A series, we highlight the engineering minds building technology across Salesforce. Today, we spotlight Shireen Nagdive, Engineering Manager at Salesforce, whose team faced a terrifying engineering problem: deliberately trigger more than 600 test failures, and still detect any genuine regression camouflaged among them.
